name: Switch
summary: Toggles a single setting on or off.
description: A toggle for a single on/off setting that takes effect immediately, rendered as a button with role="switch". The track fills with the brand color when on and a muted color when off, with an adaptive thumb whose visible edge is carried by a strong border. It covers off, on, and disabled states and binds every color and the focus ring to the system's semantic tokens.
whenToUse: Turn a single setting on or off with an immediate effect
Offer a binary preference that doesn't need a separate Save
whenNotToUse: A choice that only applies after submitting a form — use a Checkbox
Choosing one of several options — use a Radio group

checked.false: Off — muted track, thumb to the left.
checked.true: On — brand track, thumb slid to the right.

states.focus: Keyboard focus — shows the focus ring.

dos: Use a clear label that reads as an on/off state
Apply the change immediately when toggled
Keep the label stable — don't relabel the switch as it flips
donts: Don't require a separate Save for a switch — that's a Checkbox pattern
Don't use a switch for non-binary choices
Don't rely on the thumb position alone — pair with a visible label

keyboard: Tab moves focus to and from the control
notes: The thumb keeps a >=3:1 edge against the track via a strong border for low-vision users
Disabled switches are dimmed and not interactive
